Indicates whether local `xpacks` folders are non-hierarchical.

## Signature

```typescript
nonHierarchicalLocalXpacksFolder: boolean;
```

## Remarks

Legacy behavior (before 0.16.0): xpacks were stored in a flat structure within the local `xpacks` folder.

Modern behavior (0.16.0+): xpacks are organized hierarchically within the `xpacks` folder, mirroring the scoped package structure (e.g., `xpacks/@scope/package`<!-- -->).

Set to `true` for packages with minimumXpmRequired &lt; 0.16.0.
